info.title: mythical-telemetry collector HTTP API
info.summary: Ingest and aggregate anonymous product heartbeats.
info.description: The collector ingests anonymous product heartbeats (POST /v1/ingest), serves per-install and aggregate reads, and exposes an operator counters surface. The Worker twin (collector-worker) implements this SAME document over Cloudflare D1; a route-parity test binds the two. AUTH IS BY HEADER, NOT BEARER: writes and per-install reads require the x-mythical-instance-secret header (a derived per-install secret; the legacy x-mythical-write-key is also accepted), and /metrics requires x-mythical-ops-key. The docs renderer only expresses HTTP bearer schemes, so operations here declare security:[] and name the header credential in prose; this is a documentation limitation, not an auth downgrade. ERROR ENVELOPE: telemetry answers errors as a flat {ok:false, error:<token>} with deliberately coarse tokens (an absent and a wrong secret are the same answer, so the surface cannot be used as an oracle) — this predates C3's {error, message} shape and is retained by API-M3's reduced scope. api/openapi.test.ts probes the real collector with every route below.
info.x-honesty: Two documented deviations from the family convention, both retained by API-M3's reduced scope (prefix migration + first spec, not an auth or envelope re-shape): (1) auth is a custom header, not an HTTP bearer scheme, so operations declare security:[] and describe the header in prose; (2) the error envelope is telemetry's flat {ok:false, error:<lowercase token>}, not C3's {error:"SCREAMING_SNAKE", message}. The coarse error tokens are intentional anti-oracle design.

get.description: A human-facing HTML dashboard — UI delivery, not a capability route. The machine-readable equivalent is GET /v1/stats.
Aggregate-only population figures, small-cell floored. Public and unauthenticated.
Served verbatim when the operator wired one; 404 when unwired.
Operator-gated by the x-mythical-ops-key header (constant-time compared). Absent unless an ops key is configured, in which case an unknown route (404) is indistinguishable from an unconfigured one.

200.description: Counters, store gauges and throttle sizes.

post.description: Requires the x-mythical-instance-secret header (a derived per-install secret; legacy x-mythical-write-key also accepted). Per-source throttled. Coarse answers: an absent secret and a wrong secret are the same answer (write_key_mismatch), and a nonexistent identity and one you cannot authenticate for are the same answer.

get.description: Authenticated read (gate G6): requires the x-mythical-instance-secret header proving possession of THIS install's secret. Unknown and unauthenticated are the same answer.

delete.summary: Purge an install across every product (authenticated)
delete.description: Authenticated delete (gate G6): requires the x-mythical-instance-secret header. Purges the derived identity across EVERY product.

Error.description: Telemetry's flat error envelope. `error` is a coarse lowercase token; there is no `message` (anti-oracle). NOTE: this is NOT C3's {error:SCREAMING_SNAKE, message} shape — see info.x-honesty.

Heartbeat.description: One anonymous product heartbeat. See docs/FIELDS.md and packages/telemetry/schema/heartbeat.v1.json for the full field set.

InstanceStats.description: Per-install stats: window totals, per-day rates and the reporting-day metadata.

Metrics.description: Operator counters, store gauges and throttle sizes.

InvalidRequest.description: The query parameters were malformed or failed validation.

IngestInvalidPayload.description: The heartbeat body was unparseable, failed schema validation, named an unknown product, or fell outside the ingest day window.

IngestUnauthorized.description: Absent, malformed or mismatched instance secret (coarse: all indistinguishable).

PayloadTooLarge.description: The heartbeat body exceeded the hard intake cap.

Unauthorized.description: Absent or wrong credential (coarse: the two are indistinguishable).

UnknownInstance.description: No such install, or one the caller cannot authenticate for (coarse: indistinguishable).

IngestThrottled.description: Per-source throttle exceeded, or the new-instance admission cap was hit.

Internal.description: Contained internal error; body never leaks internals.
